WITH base AS (
  SELECT actor, created_at,
    CASE WHEN created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15' THEN 'prev'
         WHEN created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22' THEN 'last' END AS win
  FROM events
  WHERE repo_name = 'langchain-ai/langchain'
    AND type IN ('PushEvent','IssuesEvent','PullRequestEvent','IssueCommentEvent')
    AND actor IS NOT NULL
    AND lower(actor) NOT LIKE '%[bot]'
    AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22'
), agg AS (
  SELECT win, actor, COUNT(*) AS n FROM base GROUP BY win, actor
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE win='prev' AND n>=3) AS previous_week_contributors,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE win='last' AND n>=3) AS last_week_contributors
FROM agg

  WHERE e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00'

)
